column1: List of reported tornadoes - Saturday, March 28, 2009
column4: Four houses sustained minor to moderate damage. Two sheds were also destroyed and trees were damaged.
column8: Two camper trailer were overturned and a barn lost its roof. Several trees were damaged.
column9: Six homes were destroyed with 70 others damaged - 10 of them heavily. One vehicle was thrown 1/4 mile (400 m) from its location. Two people were injured.
column10: Small rope tornado observed by chasers with no damage
column12: Tornado caught on video by trained spotters causing damage only to trees.
column14: A modular home was destroyed with damage to three other homes. Numerous trees were snapped.
column15: Several businesses were damaged, including the local Boys and Girls Club and a shopping plaza which were heavily damaged. Numerous houses were also damaged. Damages from the tornado were estimated to be over $4.4 million.
column16: Minor damage to a house and a barn. Numerous trees snapped or broken.
column19: One home was significantly damaged with a cinder block storage being destroyed and part of the back of the home being lifted from the foundation. Three other homes were damaged. Damage to farm and other storage/cinder block buildings.
column20: Brief touchdown with damage limited to trees.
column22: Many trees, mostly tall pines, were uprooted. Some of them fell on a house, heavily damaging it.
column23: Two houses sustained roof damage and a barn was heavily damaged.
